Data.subject: Building, Real Estate, Construction and Housing
Data.title: Construction Material Market Prices, Monthly
Data.footnote: In view of the lack of business transactions for construction materials due to a stoppage/slowdown of most construction activities on the back of the Covid-19 fallout, the construction material market prices in May-July 2020 (except for steel reinforcement bars in June-July 2020) are assumed unchanged from those of April 2020.

row.footnote: Between January 2009 and December 2014, the market prices of steel reinforcement bars (without cut and bend) are based on fixed price supply contracts with contract period of 6 months or less.  From January 2015, the market prices of steel reinforcement bars (without cut and bend) are based on fixed price supply contracts with contract period of 1 year or less.
With effect from 1 January 2007, the market prices of granite exclude delivery charges to concrete batching plants.
With effect from 1 January 2007, the market prices of concreting sand exclude delivery charges to concrete batching plants.

Prior to 2007, market prices were based on 'Grade 30 Normal'.  Between January 2007 and March 2009, market prices were based on 'Grade 35 Pump'.  Between March 2009 and January 2010, market prices were based on non-fixed price contracts for 'Grade 35 Pump'.  With effect from January 2010, market prices are based on contracts with non-fixed price, fixed price and market retail price for 'Grade 40 Pump'.
